generation.note: SDXL Realistic text-to-image, 1024x1024, 1m18s, run in the UPDATED install and opened. A real image, and a different composition from the pre-update one, so it was generated rather than resurfaced. Fabio looked at it.

sourceInstall.note: Fresh extract of the published CubricVision-windows-x64-v1.4.4.zip. buildHash equals the v1.4.4 tag sha, so this is byte-for-byte what users hold.

afterUpdate.note: Engine bumped 0.31.0 -> 0.34.0 on first launch, matching 1.5.0's pin. Changelog rendered and the full landing screen populated - the screen the 1.5.0 corruption never reached.

caveats: userDataSurvived covers the PORTABLE's user-data (settings, secrets, window state): all three md5s byte-identical before and after, and again after a hard restart. Projects live in the shared Documents\Cubric Vision\Projects and would survive a corrupted install too, so they prove nothing on their own.

This is a DELTA bundle (bundleFromVersion 1.4.4) and serves 1.4.4 only. Installs older than 1.4.4 run an applier that predates the fromVersion guard, so it does not refuse - it applies silently and corrupts. The release body must tell them to take the full zip. See MPI-709 validation.md.

The offline update-from-zip.bat path prints an error and exits 1 AFTER a successful update, because the delta replaces that batch file while cmd is executing it. The Windows in-app path (main.js:1232 -> update/win-update.cjs run as node) is unaffected. Recorded, not fixed.
